state_source: preset/tone/motion/volume; active renderer clock; native scroll progress. Audio and shape derive from the same preset.

composition.short_height: below 620px natural page growth instead of compressed or overlapping content
composition.initialization: Both slots reserve their flow space from initial HTML. Fixed sculpture becomes visible only after actual placement; js-active does not toggle in-flow content.

phases.route: smoothstep from hero slot into narrow protected corridor
hold end-slot.top and smoothstep-expand into end-slot width/height/left

native_scroll.final_slot: Natural flow: heading height plus24px, then sticky visual slot. No JS-dependent in-flow layout.
native_scroll.decoration: object-spec/axis/shadow/graphics note opacity fades to0 during compact corridor and returns on arrival. Main shape stays visible.
native_scroll.geometry: Same scroll progress slightly separates the original metallic layers; same function in reverse.
native_scroll.after_arrival: follow actual native/sticky instrument slot rect
native_scroll.reduced_or_paused: immediately use slot nearest viewport center; no corridor travel
native_scroll.verification: Actual placeSculpture with synthetic rectangles:4020 assertions PASS for boundaries/clearances/motion-off. Real six-viewport trajectories remain parent browser QA.

pause.raf: one pending/explicit input frame then no continuous RAF

visibility.hidden: cancel graphics RAF; cancel pending audio resume by generation; stop/dispose audio; no automatic sound restart
visibility.pagehide: also clear UI timer, cancel pending placement frame, invalidate offline/export/import results
visibility.pageshow: restore UI timer and graphics; audio remains stopped

resize.canvas: slot bounds with fixed maximum-slot drawing buffer; DPR <=1.6 desktop /1.35 phone
resize.mesh: mobile segments selected on initial load

fallback.no_webgl: original preset-specific SVG + functional sound controls

diagnostics.performance: 20-second actual active frame intervals, LCP and max-session CLS; unsupported=null
diagnostics.layout_shift_sources: Raw max-session CLS unchanged; up to20 observed entries with source node and previous/current rectangles. Recent-input shifts recorded but excluded from CLS as defined.
